items.title: Bill Huntington Interview, 1961-12-27
items.q: I like the way Joe Watkins played time, you know. He wasn't much of a technician, but I kind of like the way he played time with the Lewis band.

ctx.x: Who did you like when you started playing? You mentioned Bonk, and then there must have been some other musicians. You said you met a lot on the mind.

Yeah, well, Bonk, and George, and Jim, and, uh, uh, let's see. I like the way Joe Watkins, was it Watkins who was playing with? I like the way Joe Watkins played time, you know. He wasn't much of a technician, but I kind of like the way he played time with the Lewis band. And of course drag had such a hell of a pulse, you know. The sitting back of drag, sitting in front of drag, you know, was really something. And, uh, and it really, really made me so, so conscious of this, this time thing, of just being able to…
Well, it's more or less that Lewis band that, that were your favorite out of that era.
